{{% callout type="info" %}}
**Where to find it:** Applications & Components → Comma → Drawing → `uDimensionSetSpacer`
{{% /callout %}}

Spaces out picked dimension sets so they no longer overlap.

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Distance** | How far apart to space the picked dimension sets (default 5). |
